en.title: Accessibility Digest: Key Updates on Healthcare Deadlines, Infrastructure, and Assistive Tech (May 5, 2026)
en.summary: Healthcare providers face an approaching deadline to enhance accessibility compliance; a Delray Beach restoration project has introduced a steep drop-off that poses accessibility challenges; Guoguang Technology unveiled high-tech assistive devices to enable barrier-free travel for people with disabilities; Jacksonville’s legislative portal has been offline for several weeks while the city implements accessibility upgrades.

highlights.title: Deadline Looms For Healthcare Providers To Improve Accessibility
Delray Beach restoration project creates steep drop-off, raising accessibility concerns
Guoguang Technology Unveils High-Tech Assistive Devices to Enable Barrier-Free Travel for People with Disabilities
Jacksonville’s legislative portal down for multiple weeks, as city makes accessibility upgrades

zh-TW.title: 無障礙每日摘要：醫療截止日期、基礎設施與輔助科技重點更新（2026年5月5日）
zh-TW.summary: 醫療提供者面臨即將到來的無障礙合規截止日期；Delray Beach修復項目產生陡坡，對行人和輪椅使用者構成無障礙通行問題；大國科技展示高科技輔助器具，幫助殘障人士實現無障礙出行；杰克逊维尔立法門户因無障礙升級而離線數週，市政府正在進行改善以提升殘障人士的訪問。

highlights.title: 醫療提供者面臨改善無障礙設施的截止日期
Delray Beach修復項目產生陡坡，引發無障礙擔憂
大國科技｜高科技輔助器具先後亮相助殘障人士實現無障礙出行
杰克逊维尔立法门户因无障碍升级而下线数周
